name: Magus Spellcarved Soldier
body:
Some battleforged were built to merge magic and combat in a unique way where they carve magic directly into their armor.

Requirement: A spellcarved soldier must be a battleforged.

Spellcarved Runes (Su)

At 1st level, a spellcarved soldier gains the ability to inscribe defensive runes upon their bodies that protects them in combat. They can only have one rune active at any given time, but changing which rune is active or activating a rune is a swift action which causes the rune in question to glow. A rune remains active for 1 hour per class level, or until deactivated as a free action. At 8th level, the spellcarved soldier can have two runes active simultaneously, though each rune requires a separate swift action to activate or change. At 16th level, they can have three runes active simultaneously. The spellcarved gains the following runes at the listed levels:

Rune of Extension

At 1st level, a spellcarved soldier can activate a rune that empowers any spell they cast upon themselves. While the rune is active they can treat one magus spell they cast that has a duration greater than instantaneous and affects them as if it is affected by the Extend Spell metamagic feat. This does not stack with uses of the feat and only one spell can be affected by the rune at a time. Additionally, any spell affected by this rune has its dispel DC increased by +5. At 10th level, the spellcarved soldier can have two spells affected by this rune simultaneously and three at 20th level.

Rune of Resistance

At 1st level, a spellcarved soldier can activate a rune that protects them from spells. They gain a +2 bonus on saves vs. spells and spell-like abilities. This increases to +4 on saves vs. spells that affect metal or wood to which they are naturally susceptible. These bonuses double at 15th level. See the body of metal and wood ancestral ability for the battleforged for more information.

Rune of Fortification

At 8th level, a spellcarved soldier can activate a rune that protects their vitals. For the duration they are considered to have light fortification (25%). At 12th level, this increases to moderate fortification (50%), heavy fortification (75%) at 16th level, and immunity to criticals and precision damage at 20th.

Rune of the Archmage

At 12th level, a spellcarved soldier can activate a rune that increases the potency of their magical capacity. They can gain the benefit from a third magic ring that is worn and they increase the caster level of any magus spell they cast by 1.

Rune of Warding

At 16th level, a spellcarved soldier can activate a rune that directly protects them from harm. They gain a DR 5/- and a resistance 10 to two different energy types, chosen when the rune is activated.

This ability replaces spell combat, improved spell combat, greater spell combat, and true magus.
